questions.explanation_english: HECI stands for Higher Education Commission of India, which NEP 2020 proposes as a single overarching regulatory body for higher education, replacing multiple existing regulators like UGC and AICTE. Medical and legal education are excluded from HECI's purview and will continue to be regulated by their respective councils.
